features.name: WiFi
features.description: Wireless networking support for connected features.
features.tooltip: Provides the WiFi stack used by OTA updates, discovery, web tools, and connected plugins.

features.name: mDNS
features.description: Local network discovery without an IP address.
features.tooltip: Advertises the scale on the local network using multicast DNS. WiFi is included automatically.

features.name: Web server
features.tooltip: Adds the embedded HTTP server for web settings, APIs, and approved web plugins.

features.name: WebSocket
features.description: Bidirectional live updates for web clients.
features.tooltip: Enables persistent browser communication and includes WiFi and the web server.

features.name: Runtime LittleFS files
features.description: Bundle files in the runtime flash filesystem.
features.tooltip: Adds runtime assets such as HTML, configuration, or plugin resources to LittleFS.

features.name: ElegantOTA
features.tooltip: Adds ElegantOTA and includes WiFi and the web server.

features.name: OLED Pull OTA
features.description: Install official releases from the scale display.
features.tooltip: Downloads signed firmware and LittleFS release assets over WiFi from the OLED update flow.

features.name: Grinder
features.tooltip: Adds grinder connectivity and includes WiFi and mDNS.

features.name: Energy Saving
features.tooltip: Adds the Energy Saving menu and its persistent feature toggles.

plugins.name: Hello Web
plugins.description: Example web plugin with bundled runtime assets.
plugins.tooltip: Approved example plugin requiring WiFi, the web server, and runtime LittleFS files.
